sources.attribution: Weather forecast data: Open-Meteo; see provider documentation for model attribution.
Tide predictions: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS).
Hourly weather and marine (wave) forecasts for visit guidance: Open-Meteo.
Tide datums (great diurnal range): NOAA CO-OPS metadata API; the spring-tide indicator compares the day's range against it.
